# WXYJ Content System

Canonical name: 威熏邑境自媒体内容生成系统
English name: WXYJ Content System
Skill ID: wxyj-content-system
Version: 2.7.0

Purpose:
A brand-specific Codex Skill for 威熏邑境, currently centered on
马克瑞普之选亚伯乐1996年单桶 across Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and WeChat
Channels. It bundles product knowledge, 17 AIGC product references, titles,
captions, tags, comments, prompts, storyboards, QA, and content-run folders.

Primary documentation:
- README.md
- docs/getting-started.md
- docs/content-contract.md
- docs/output-structure.md
- docs/naming-convention.md
- docs/compliance.md
- references/editorial-art-direction.md
- references/content-diversity-system.md
- SKILL.md
- assets/products/mackillops-choice-aberlour-1996/asset-manifest.json

Important boundaries:
- Real product facts must be checked against labels and files.
- AIGC supports expression and must not impersonate real evidence.
- Generated media is incomplete without matching publish copy and QA.
- Video full frames, first frames, last frames, and covers are native 9:16.
- Douyin and WeChat Channels share one video-master.
- External Seedance handoff is platform-neutral and lives in video-master/external-generation.
- Original returns stay in video-master/incoming; validated copies enter accepted.
- Use scripts/create_external_video_handoff.py to package shots.
- Use scripts/validate_external_video_return.py to validate returned video.
- Use scripts/validate_release_preflight.py before final delivery.
- Use scripts/validate_content_diversity.py against the recent creative ledger before release.
- Use scripts/analyze_performance.py against the performance log before planning the next run; only mature data can create prompt rules.
- Paid ChatCut generation requires explicit authorization in the current task.

This file is a concise agent-reading aid.
